51599240.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human cGAS assessed as dissociation constant measured upto 240 secs by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface Plasmon: SPR experiments were performed using CM5 sensor chips in a BIACORE 8K (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. cGAS was immobilized to a final density of 18,000 RU. All experiments were carried out with a running buffer containing 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.5), 150 mM KCl, 20 mM MgCl2, and 0.1% DMSO. Sample-dependent responses were subtracted from channel 1, which had no protein immobilized on it. Data were further corrected by subtracting a zero-concentration blank from all compounds. Compounds were injected for 120 s, and dissociation was measured for 120 s at 30 μL/min. Samples were injected with a top concentration, followed by 2-fold dilutions, and a final blank over 7 injection points. Dissociation equilibrium constants (Kd) were determined using a kinetics model (Biacore Insight Evaluation software). Competition assays were carried out using the A-B-A injection type in a BIACORE 8K (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. All competition experiments were carried out with running buffer containing 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.5), 150 mM KCl, 20 mM MgCl2, and 5% DMSO. Solutions with 30 μM 30d-S were used in the Injection A module, with preanalyte contact time in 180 s and postanalyte contact time in 180 s. Solutions containing 30 μM 30d-S and 2 mM ATP or GTP were used in the Injection B module, with contact time in 180 s. Competition analyses were determined using a kinetics model (Biacore Insight Evaluation software).
original_paragraph.Figure 6 caption: Figure 6. Competitive binding assays of compound 30d-S with either ATP or GTP with h-cGAS by SPR. (A) The binding affinity of ATP with h-cGAS. (B) The competition assays of 30d-S against ATP with h-cGAS using A-B-A injection mode. (C) The binding affinity of GTP with h-cGAS. (D) The competition assays of 30d-S against GTP with h-cGAS using A-B-A injection mode.
